_doc: Single source of defaults for Basekit scripts. Override any key with an environment variable named BASEKIT_<KEY_IN_UPPERCASE>, for example in the "env" block of ~/.claude/settings.json (all projects) or .claude/settings.json (one project).
_scan_interval_hours: Minimum hours between session-start toolkit scans. Sessions inside the interval add zero tokens.
_scout_stale_days: Days after which the session scan mentions that the vetted registry is due for a /basekit:scout review.
_scan_timeout_ms: Upper bound for the `claude plugin list` call made by the scan.
_scan_max_listed: Maximum plugin names listed per category in the scan summary.
_secret_guard: block | warn | off. block denies a write or commit that contains a high-confidence secret.
_config_lint: advise | off. advise reports likely hardcoded configuration after an edit; it never blocks.
_config_lint_max_findings: Maximum findings reported per edit, to keep the note short.
_gitleaks_timeout_ms: Upper bound for the optional gitleaks run in the commit guard.
_scout_max_candidates: Maximum new candidates /basekit:scout evaluates per run.
